segments.name: Cloud-based software platform
segments.description: Provides an end-to-end, AI powered cloud-based software platform that helps trades customers connect, manage and automate their business workflows.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has determined that it operates in a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers in the trades pay for an AI powered cloud-based software platform that connects, manages and automates business workflows such as scheduling, dispatching, invoicing and payment processing.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives substantially all revenue from platform services.
